Implemented and validated the optimization.

**Diagnosis**
The semantically removable source was `unified.mrope`: the baseline prefill tree emitted three old device-side `elementwise` proxy leaves, `rot_pos_emb`, `get_window_index`, and `old_cu_seqlens`, whose necessary-work semantics were empty. They duplicated preparation already represented by the four assembled mRoPE H2D transfers. Required decoder work, including `post_attn.activation`, was preserved. Before leaves are recorded by `pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`; after leaves by the corresponding after resource token.

**Evidence**
Derived from the exact Analyzer child ladders (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`), the prefill `unified.mrope` scope changed:

`R0`: `0.000020231303409673277` -> `0.000016201626975089315` GPU·s
`R5`: `7.877398437500001e-8` -> `2.6258000000000006e-8` GPU·s
`R6/R7`: `1.4e-11` / `1.4e-11` -> unchanged

The full prefill iteration changed from R0/R5/R6/R7 `(0.003804338216781616, 0.0010067282293270102, 0.0008731360487079111, 0.0008715154518471112)` to `(0.0038003084659576415, 0.0010066757133426352, 0.0008731360487079111, 0.0008715154518471112)` GPU·s (`pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown`). Decode R0/R5/R6/R7 stayed exactly `(0.0026057627201080324, 0.000004779351927962786, 0.000004365373536711111, 0.000002788848071111111)` GPU·s (`pred.casev1.optimality-breakdown`).

Before mRoPE leaves: the three `elementwise` proxies plus `rotary_pos_emb`, `window_index`, `cu_window_seqlens`, and `cu_seqlens` H2D leaves. After: only those four H2D leaves remain; total tree leaves fell from 20 to 17.

**Fix**
[`simulator/src/worklet/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_local.rs:139`](simulator/src/worklet/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_local.rs:139) makes the before recipe’s extra build/compile/eval path empty, so only the four H2D transfers are emitted. The decoder is unchanged. The optimized v2 map and historical v1 map are in [`model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified.json:1`](model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified.json:1) and [`model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified_legacy.json:1`](model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified_legacy.json:1). Commits: `8b983c6`, `709c2b7`.

Both predictions were cache-only under `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''`; `profiling/profile.db` stayed 14,942,208 bytes with unchanged mtime, and no `--profile` was used. Focused simulator, model-work, Analyzer-location, and diff checks passed. Rustfmt was unavailable because it is not installed. Artifacts remain in [`logs/eval_before_run`](logs/eval_before_run) and [`logs/eval_after_run`](logs/eval_after_run).

judge.reasoning: The agent identified the redundant mRoPE preparation work as the bottleneck, matching the ground truth. Its implemented fix removes those three proxy leaves while retaining the four H2D transfers and decoder computation.
